name: light-edge-vertical
title: Light Edge (vertical)
description: Vertical: red, white and grey light races around the edge of an orb, the object centred on the field. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT); brand colours by default (dark ground, red and grey); every colour is a variable. Placement full, top or bottom card; fades in and out on cues.
